# pve_sdn_zone_qinq (Data Source)

Reads a QinQ SDN zone from `GET /cluster/sdn/zones/{zone}`. Errors when the zone's upstream type is not `qinq`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_zone_qinq" "zone1" {
  zone = "zone1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The SDN zone object identifier to look up (2 to 8 characters, starting with a letter).

### Read-Only

- `bridge` (String) The local bridge (PVE `bridge`) on each node where the service VLAN for this zone is managed.
- `dhcp` (String) Name of the DHCP server backend for this zone (PVE `dhcp`). Must be one of: `dnsmasq`.
- `digest` (String) The read-only SDN configuration revision (PVE `digest`) of the zone section.
- `dns` (String) ID of the DNS API server (PVE `dns`) for this zone.
- `dnszone` (String) DNS domain zone for this zone (PVE `dnszone`).
- `ipam` (String) ID of the IPAM (PVE `ipam`) managing IP addresses in this zone.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the zone (PVE `mtu`), used for the created VNet bridges.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names where this zone is created (PVE `pve-node-list`).
- `reversedns` (String) ID of the reverse DNS server (PVE `reversedns`) for this zone.
- `tag` (Number) Service-VLAN tag, i.e. the outer VLAN id of the QinQ zone (PVE `tag`).
- `vlan_protocol` (String) VLAN protocol used for the QinQ zone (PVE `vlan-protocol`). Must be one of: `802.1q`, `802.1ad`.
